name: contacts-dashboard
description: Contacts Management Dashboard — Angular SPA + GraphQL BFF (Apollo Server + DataLoader)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n bff,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:bff" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=bff && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=bff && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
